title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your proposal and the updated forecast for part 360020. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

While we can support a 24-month contract term, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms. With this adjustment to the payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €4.88 per unit, a contract term of 24 months.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal: volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

On volume: we commit to 20,000 pc per year for 24 or 36 months, as in the attached term sheets.

Your own figures put the cost increase at about 0.8%: LCI-C at 2.7% on a 10% share and PPI-C2815 at 0.8% on a 65% share. Your 4.94 is 12.5% above our current 4.39.

Your scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 shows 302 ppm, twice your 150 ppm commitment. The same scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 85.0%.

Your owner offered to walk us through the calculation. Could you arrange an authorised pricing review with him? Is there a cheaper variant of the 6306-2Z C3 you could offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal: volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As to the quality record data you cited, that does not change our position. We have reviewed your volume commitment and the quality records you cited; however, these factors do not alter our calculation or price basis.

Our current offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative, based on your requested 36-month term and 60-day payment period, we can offer a price of €4.91 per unit with a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – 36-month volume agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the revised offer. To be exact on commitment: 20,000 pc per year, binding for 36 months, 60,000 pc in total. That is the multi-year volume agreement your colleagues told us is what changes prices for standard items.

Your own cost basis shows an increase of under 1%, while 4.94 is about 12.5% above our current 4.39. A three-year agreement also saves you renewal effort and secures planned, stock-based demand.

Please consider the attached package. If 4.50 is not possible, could you arrange an authorised pricing review and tell us the lowest price you can give for 36 months at 90 days?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – 36-month volume agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We must maintain our offer of €4.94 per unit for a 36-month contract with 90-day payment terms. Thus, our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Please provide data quantifying the savings you claim a three-year agreement generates for our operations. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
